meta.name: pre-mortem
meta.description: Run a pre-mortem risk analysis on a PRD or launch plan. Categorizes risks as Tigers (real problems), Paper Tigers (overblown concerns), and Elephants (unspoken worries), then classifies as launch-blocking, fast-follow, or track. Use when preparing for launch, stress-testing a product plan, or identifying what could go wrong.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在发布前识别并分类潜在风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在上线前系统性地找出产品方案中的隐患
copy.tagline_en: Identify and categorize potential risks before launch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically uncover hidden risks in your product plan before launch

howto.what: Claude 会分析你提供的产品需求文档或发布计划，假设发布失败，反向找出三类风险：老虎（真实问题）、纸老虎（过度担忧）、大象（未言明的顾虑），并给出行动方案。
howto.when: 当你提供产品需求文档或发布计划，并要求进行预检风险分析时触发。

say.text: 请对我的新产品发布计划做一次预检分析。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划并输出风险分类和行动方案。

say.text: 分析这份 PRD，找出可能失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会按老虎、纸老虎、大象分类风险。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your PRD or launch plan, imagines launch failure, and categorizes risks as Tigers (real problems), Paper Tigers (overblown concerns), and Elephants (unspoken worries), then provides action plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PRD or launch plan and ask for a pre-mortem risk analysis.

say_en.text: Run a pre-mortem on my new product launch plan.
say_en.note: Claude will read the plan and output risk categories and action plans.

say_en.text: Analyze this PRD for potential failure reasons.
say_en.note: Claude will classify risks as Tigers, Paper Tigers, and Elephants.
